exceptions.name: Admin · sample
exceptions.reason: The shell prints /me as name · roles (A-14). The fidelity tool scopes --cookies to the page folder (/setup/rules/), so the mock answers the default persona and the bar reads 'Ada Okafor · Finance Lead'; under the admin cookie it reads 'Ada Okafor · Admin'.

exceptions.name: Ada Okafor · Admin
exceptions.reason: As 'Admin · sample': the persona text comes from /me (A-14).

exceptions.name: Setup
exceptions.reason: Assumption A-7: the tabs change routes, so they are a nav of links with aria-current (same look), not ARIA tabs; the tool reads them as a navigation area.

exceptions.name: Rule
exceptions.reason: The board draws the Rule label as a span; the page uses a real <label> for its <select>, which the tool lists as the field's label, not as text.

exceptions.name: Who may assign an RFP to a PM
exceptions.reason: The board draws the Rule picker as a text box; the page draws a native <select> (listed as Drop-down 'Rule') holding the same rule.

exceptions.name: PMO Lead
exceptions.reason: The board shows PMO Lead twice (leftover of the 13 Nov Head of PMO merge, PMO-0-4); options come from the API, so one PMO Lead checkbox is on the page.

exceptions.name: Today, 12 Nov 2026

exceptions.name: ← Setup
exceptions.reason: The phone back link is now the frame's slot (usePhoneBack, PR #17, D-23/D-28). It shows exactly '← Setup' in the board's place (visual 99+), but the frame gives every back link the accessible name 'Back to <label>' (frame-phone-back build note and technical review, WCAG 2.5.3 holds), so the tool lists it as link 'Back to Setup'. Same link, same href (/setup/roles); the name belongs to the shared frame, not this feature.
